fullPassage: Adults make their own decisions, and children have most of their decisions made for them. Teenagers, of course, are stuck somewhere in the middle. As they gradually gain more freedom, they must learn to plan what to do with that freedom. To equip them for this, they are poised at the most exciting point in the story of human cerebral change — the human brain changes throughout life, but that change is most complex in the second decade. Recent scientific discoveries go a long way towards showing that adolescence is, perhaps surprisingly, the high point of the human brain — when the brain is at its largest, most flexible, and most changeable. The teenage years are when our greatest asset — our mind — is most strongly shaped. Change in the teenage body is important, but for humans, change in the brain is more important still.

questions.passage: Adults make their own decisions, and children have most of their decisions made for them. Teenagers, of course, are stuck somewhere in the middle. As they (A)[suddenly / gradually] gain more freedom, they must learn to plan what to do with that freedom. To equip them for this, they are poised at the most exciting point in the story of human cerebral change — the human brain changes throughout life, but that change is most complex in the second decade. Recent scientific discoveries go a long way towards showing that adolescence is, perhaps surprisingly, the high point of the human brain — when the brain is at its largest, most (B)[flexible / rigid], and most changeable. The teenage years are when our greatest asset — our mind — is most strongly (C)[shaped / ignored]. Change in the teenage body is important, but for humans, change in the brain is more important still.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
③ gradually — flexible — shaped ←정답

① suddenly — flexible — shaped: (A)에 suddenly(갑자기)는 부적절. 청소년이 '점차(gradually)' 더 많은 자유를 얻는다는 맥락.

② gradually — rigid — shaped: (B)에 rigid(경직된)는 부적절. 뇌가 가장 '유연한(flexible)' 시기라는 맥락.

④ gradually — flexible — ignored: (C)에 ignored(무시된)는 부적절. 우리의 마음이 가장 강하게 '형성된다(shaped)'는 맥락.

det.analysis:
② equip — complex — important ←정답

① equip — simple — important: (B)에 simple(단순한)은 부적절. 두 번째 10년에서의 뇌 변화가 가장 '복잡하다(complex)'는 맥락.

③ discourage — complex — important: (A)에 discourage(낙담시키다)는 부적절. 이를 위해 청소년들을 '갖추게 한다(equip)'는 맥락.

④ equip — complex — trivial: (C)에 trivial(사소한)은 부적절. 뇌의 변화가 더 '중요하다(important)'는 맥락.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① somewhere in the middle(중간 어딘가에) ←정답: 어른은 스스로 결정하고, 아이는 결정을 받는다 → 청소년은 그 '중간 어딘가에' 끼어 있다는 문맥.

② at the very top(꼭대기에): 어른과 아이 사이의 중간이라는 맥락과 맞지 않음.

③ far behind others(다른 사람들보다 한참 뒤에): 결정권의 중간 위치와 무관.

④ outside the boundary(경계 밖에): 어른-아이 사이라는 맥락과 맞지 않음.

questions.passage: Adults make their own decisions, and children have most of their decisions made for them. Teenagers, of course, are stuck somewhere in the middle. As they gradually gain more freedom, they must learn to plan what to do with that freedom. To equip them for this, they are poised at the most exciting point in the story of human cerebral change — the human brain changes throughout life, but that change is most complex in the second decade. Recent scientific discoveries __________ showing that adolescence is, perhaps surprisingly, the high point of the human brain — when the brain is at its largest, most flexible, and most changeable. The teenage years are when our greatest asset — our mind — is most strongly shaped. Change in the teenage body is important, but for humans, change in the brain is more important still.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ~에 크게 기여하다(go a long way towards)
det.analysis:
④ go a long way towards(~에 크게 기여하다) ←정답: 최근 과학적 발견들이 청소년기가 뇌의 정점임을 보여주는 데 '크게 기여한다'는 문맥에 적절.

① fall far short of(~에 한참 못 미치다): 발견들이 보여주는 데 '못 미친다'는 것은 문맥과 반대.

② have nothing to do with(~와 무관하다): 발견이 보여주는 것과 '무관하다'는 것은 문맥과 모순.

③ cast serious doubt on(~에 심각한 의문을 제기하다): 발견이 의문을 제기한다면 청소년기가 정점이 아니라는 의미로 문맥과 반대.
